sources.fact: LBBD80/EA Barking Station is 2.56ha, 1193 net dwellings, deliverable=yes; notes say only part of site is permissioned for 198 homes at Trocoll House.
EA has point POINT (0.081024 51.539423) and blank geometry; point is not site/title polygon.
Brownfield entry carries a planning-history link for the permissioned Trocoll component but does not establish permission for the whole 1193-home allocation.
Exact Trocoll application is 18/01927/FUL for 198 Build to Rent homes with commercial/public-house re-provision.
The committee addendum confirms 198 residential units; this is the permissioned sub-site count, not the full EA allocation.
Committee report records previous permission 15/00651/FUL had lapsed, preventing reuse of the old consent as current whole-site evidence.
Trocoll application site is immediately east of Barking Station and includes Trocoll House plus rear car-park land; this described application site is not automatically the entire EA allocation.
Adopted Local Plan allocation EA Barking Station has indicative net minimum capacity 1193.
Adopted site-allocation proformas identify EA Barking Station as a housing-led allocation; allocation is policy evidence, not permission.
Local Plan HRA table records EA at 1182 proposed homes with 198 having permission at that assessment stage, reinforcing partial-permission semantics.
Be First recorded a February 2022 funding/development deal for 198 Trocoll homes and anticipated construction start; it concerns the Trocoll component, not 1193 homes.
LBBD states all Brownfield Register sites require planning permission; register inclusion itself does not grant consent.

examples.result: EA is retained as 1193-home allocation with only 198-home Trocoll component evidenced as permissioned.
18/01927/FUL is bound to Trocoll, not automatically to the whole EA allocation.
Lapsed 15/00651/FUL is not treated as current permission.
Brownfield point is not converted into the EA allocation polygon.
Local Plan capacity is not converted into consented units.
Historic HRA count difference 1182 versus adopted 1193 is preserved as temporal/source-version evidence.
2022 delivery/funding evidence is not treated as proof that all 1193 homes are delivered or consented.
Promotion remains zero without exact EA site polygon, exact HMLR title relation and current whole-site planning status.
